verdict.rationale: Statsig publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.0 document for its Console API at the versioned path api.statsig.com/openapi/20240601.json. The Console API introduction links this spec and commits to keeping it up to date, and the API is explicitly versioned with a stability guarantee. The core story, downloading a machine-readable API spec, is delivered. missing for 10: no spec evidenced for the HTTP evaluation/events API, poor discoverability (the unversioned /openapi.json returns 403 and the common docs paths return 404), and no independent or hands-on corroboration of using the spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
